title: HeaderForm::URLs semantics defined by mail-parser address parser, not RFC 2369 — implementation choice in public contract
close_reason: Fixed: URLs form now uses a dedicated RFC 2369 bracket tokenizer rather than mail-parser's address parser. Bare URLs (no <...> framing) produce empty result per RFC 8621 §4.1.2.7. URLs containing commas, colons (tel:, https:), and CRLF folding artifacts are now handled correctly. Contract is mime-tree's own, not delegated.
